{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS220 |prevtitle=Going to Eleven with Loudred & Exploud I |nextcode=PS222 |nexttitle=Short Shrift for Shiftry |series=Ruby & Sapphire |colorscheme=Hoenn}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Going to Eleven with Loudred & Exploud II |subtitle=Escape |title_ja=VS ドゴーム & バクオング II |title_ro=VS Dogohmb & Bakuong II |image=PS221.png |scheme=Ruby & Sapphire |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 221 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|18}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 221 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|18}} |location=[[Rusturf Tunnel]] }} '''Going to Eleven with Loudred and Exploud II''' (Japanese: '''VS ドゴーム & バクオング II''' ''VS {{tt|Dogohmb|Loudred}} & {{tt|Bakuong|Exploud}} II''), titled '''VS Loudred & Exploud II''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 221st chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 41st chapter of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. It is subtitled '''Escape''' (Japanese: '''脱出 そして''' ''Escape, And'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Escape, And...''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} As [[Courtney]] asks {{adv|Ruby}} to join [[Team Magma]], a powerful sound wave shoots through the cave, sending them flying. Courtney quickly realizes that it must have been a {{m|Hyper Voice}} attack, which was fired from the {{p|Loudred}} and {{p|Exploud}} earlier. Confused at Courtney's offer, Ruby goes to check on his Pokémon, which are badly hurt from Courtney's attacks, including [[Mumu]], whose water supply evaporates. Courtney demands an answer from Ruby, but he decides to put his team into their {{i|Poké Ball}}s and send them off with Mumu. Angered at Ruby's decision to sacrifice himself, Courtney decides to burn Ruby to death for acting like a hero. Ruby corrects her, as he reveals that he never intended to keep only his Pokémon safe. Courtney quickly discovers yarn tied around her head, which is also connected to Ruby's [[Pokéblock Case]]. As Mumu runs, the yarn from the sweater Ruby put on him unravels as it is put over a large boulder, pulling Ruby and Courtney into the air. Ruby reveals that with Mumu's radar, he knew that [[Gabby and Ty|Gabby, Ty]], [[Wanda]], and {{adv|Riley}} were driving into the cave. The others arrive in the [[Hoenn TV]] van, which Mumu and Ruby land on. As Courtney demands that Ruby come back, Ruby cuts the yarn line, dropping her into the raging flames below. Later, Courtney walks out the flames, burnt but still alive. She gets a call from [[Blaise]], who asks her how her search for the [[Red Orb]] went. Courtney states she has lost interest in the search and has changed her focus onto another subject. She asks Blaise if he can take over the search instead, which Blaise figures out is because of Ruby. Courtney asks Blaise to tell their leader that she'll be gone for a while. As Ruby rides the van to safety, Courtney swears that she won't give up. Suddenly, the [[Scanner]] begins working, much to Blaise's surprise. He is shocked to find that the Red Orb and the [[Blue Orb]] are actually in the same location. He checks it to find that they are located at [[Mt. Pyre]]. The counter of the bet continues at 38 days. ==Major events== * [[Courtney]] offers {{adv|Ruby}} to join [[Team Magma]], only to be refused. * Ruby escapes Courtney's clutches. * Courtney gives up her search for the [[Red Orb]] to focus on Ruby instead. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Ruby}} * [[Blaise]]/{{tt|Mack|Chuang Yi}} * [[Courtney]]/{{tt|Marge|Chuang Yi}} * [[Gabby and Ty]]/{{tt|Maryann and Tyler|Chuang Yi}} * [[Wanda]]/{{tt|Wallene|Chuang Yi}} * {{adv|Riley}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Mightyena}} ([[Nana]]; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Delcatty}} ([[Kiki]]/{{tt|Coco|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Marshtomp}} ([[Mumu]]/{{tt|Zuzu|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Feebas}} ([[Feefee]]/{{tt|Mimi|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Castform}} ([[Fofo]]/{{tt|Popo|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Ninetales}} ([[Courtney]]'s) * {{p|Swellow}} ([[Courtney]]'s) ==Trivia== * The title for this chapter used in the English translation by [[VIZ Media]] is a reference to the movie {{wp|This Is Spinal Tap}}. In the film, the band has a stage amplifier that has a dial which allows a {{wp|Up to eleven|maximum volume of 11}}, rather than ten. This ties into the fact that {{p|Loudred}} and {{p|Exploud}}, the focus of the chapter, are both known for extreme loudness. ===Errors=== * In the [[VIZ Media]] version, the time left until the deadline at the end of the chapter is listed as 36 days instead of 38 days stated in Japanese. ==In other languages== {| |- style="vertical-align:top" | '''Title''' {{Epilang|color=9999FF|bordercolor=FF7777 |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 吼爆彈&爆音怪 II|VS Loudred & Exploud II}} (Taiwan)
